## Walk the Sweet Orange Rice Field Trail

results.title: The best things to do in Ubud Bali - Life With Bugo
results.content:
The beauty of Ubud is how the Balinese culture is still so prevalent everywhere. One of the best things to do in Ubud, Bali is to watch a traditional performance. Ubud Water Palace is actually the perfect place to enjoy this Balinese tradition. There are staged performances every evening for a little fee. Every Sunday, there is a dance performance at 7.30 PM, and you are welcome to watch for 100 000 IDR (about £5). All around Ubud, there are posters inviting you to dance performances. [...] The best things to do in Ubud Bali - Sumampan waterfall  
 Sumampan waterfall

Visiting Sumampan is one of the best things to do in Ubud Bali. It’s not as imposing as the typical Bali waterfalls but if you are like me, you’ll love it.

We had it to ourselves for the first 45 mins while debating whether to get in or not. It was peaceful to just sit around and listen to the sound of the water. We eventually went in and the water was fresh. [...] #### The best things to do in Ubud Bali

###### 1. Ubud Water Palace

Ubud Water Palace is the residence of the Ubud Royal Family and is free to visit. It is also a Temple, Puri Saren Agung and is a must visit in Ubud. The Palace has a gorgeous courtyard and walking around, you get to see very well preserved Balinese architecture built between 1800-1823.

results.title: Karsa Spa Ubud: Traditional Balinese Massage by the Rice Fields — AccessiaPass
results.content:
Walking the Campuhan Ridge Walk in the morning is one of the best ways to discover Ubud. At the far end of the ridge, in the village of Bangkiang Sidem, lies Karsa Spa — an open-air spa perched beside rice paddies and lotus ponds. With no glass walls or noisy air conditioning, treatments here blend with the sound of water, rustling rice stalks, and birdsong. This is the purest form of Ubud relaxation.
